scripts.py:lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m mypy app tests scripts
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose -f Solution/docker-compose.yml up -d --no-build --wait app db
scripts.e2e:walkthrough: npm exec -w Solution/tests -- playwright test -c e2e/walkthrough.config.ts
scripts.trial:up: docker compose -p kanban-trial -f Solution/docker-compose.yml -f Solution/docker-compose.trial.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.seed: npm exec -w Solution/tests -- tsx fixtures/seed-trial.ts && node scripts/py.mjs -m scripts.seed_data
scripts.trial:down: docker compose -p kanban-trial -f Solution/docker-compose.yml -f Solution/docker-compose.trial.yml down
scripts.trial:backup: docker exec kanban-trial-db-1 pg_dump -U postgres -Fc app
scripts.trial:up:entra: docker compose -p kanban-trial --env-file Solution/.env -f Solution/docker-compose.yml -f Solution/docker-compose.trial.yml up -d --build --wait
